# ART Runner - GUI tool to execute SQL files and export results to Excel
# Author: Generated by M365 Copilot
# Description: Opens to a GUI with "Run ART Now!" button and a save location field. When run, it
# executes all .sql files in the fixed folder (see SQL_FOLDER), writes any tabular results to Excel
# (one sheet per result set), saves to the chosen location, and opens the Excel file.

import os
import re
import sys
import threading
import traceback
from datetime import datetime

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, filedialog, messagebox

import pandas as pd

# Optional import of pyodbc; we handle helpful error if missing
try:
    import pyodbc
except Exception as e:
    pyodbc = None

# ====== Configuration ======
# Fixed folder containing .sql files to run
SQL_FOLDER = r"C:\\Users\\msaunders\\Desktop\\ART 2.0 SQL"

# ====== Utility helpers ======

def ensure_pyodbc_available():
    if pyodbc is None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "The Python package 'pyodbc' is not installed. Please install requirements with '\n'"
            "    pip install -r requirements.txt\n"
            "and make sure a Microsoft ODBC Driver for SQL Server (17 or 18) is installed on this machine."
        )


def try_sql_server_connection(server: str, database: str, auth_mode: str, username: str = None, password: str = None):
    """Attempt a connection using ODBC Driver 18 first, fall back to 17. Returns a live connection."""
    ensure_pyodbc_available()

    drivers_to_try = ["ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server", "ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server", "SQL Server"]

    last_err = None
    for drv in drivers_to_try:
        try:
            if auth_mode == "Windows (Integrated)":
                conn_str = f"DRIVER={{{{ {drv} }}}};SERVER={server};DATABASE={database};Trusted_Connection=yes;"
            else:
                # SQL Login
                # For ODBC Driver 18, explicitly disable encryption validation if needed. Adjust as necessary.
                # You can add: TrustServerCertificate=yes to bypass cert validation on dev servers.
                conn_str = (
                    f"DRIVER={{{{ {drv} }}}};SERVER={server};DATABASE={database};"
                    f"UID={username};PWD={password};"
                )

            # For Driver 18, encryption is on by default; if you run into issues, append:
            #   Encrypt=yes;TrustServerCertificate=yes;
            # conn_str += "Encrypt=yes;TrustServerCertificate=yes;"

            cnxn = pyodbc.connect(conn_str, timeout=30)
            return cnxn
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = e
            continue

    raise RuntimeError(
        "Unable to connect to SQL Server. Last error: " + (str(last_err) if last_err else "Unknown error")
    )


def split_sql_batches(sql_text: str):
    """Split SQL script into batches on lines that contain only GO (case-insensitive)."""
    # Normalize newlines and split on GO batch separators
    pattern = re.compile(r"^\s*GO\s*;?\s*$", re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE)
    parts = re.split(pattern, sql_text)
    # Strip whitespace; keep non-empty
    return [p.strip() for p in parts if p.strip()]


def fetch_all_result_sets(cursor):
    """Yield (columns, rows) for each result set in the current executed statement."""
    while True:
        if cursor.description is not None:
            cols = [d[0] for d in cursor.description]
            try:
                rows = cursor.fetchall()
            except Exception:
                rows = []
            yield cols, rows
        # Move to next result set; if none, break
        if not cursor.nextset():
            break


def safe_sheet_name(name: str):
    # Excel sheet name limit 31 chars, disallow: : \\ / ? * [ ]
    invalid = set(':\\/?*[]')
    cleaned = ''.join(c for c in name if c not in invalid)
    return cleaned[:31] if cleaned else 'Sheet'


class ARTRunnerApp(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("ART Runner")
        self.geometry("600x360")
        self.resizable(False, False)

        # State vars
        self.save_dir_var = tk.StringVar(value=self.default_save_dir())
        self.server_var = tk.StringVar(value="")
        self.database_var = tk.StringVar(value="")
        self.auth_mode_var = tk.StringVar(value="Windows (Integrated)")
        self.username_var = tk.StringVar(value="")
        self.password_var = tk.StringVar(value="")

        self.create_widgets()
        self.update_auth_fields()

    def default_save_dir(self):
        # Default to user's Documents
        try:
            return os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), "Documents")
        except Exception:
            return os.getcwd()

    def create_widgets(self):
        pad = 10

        # Save location
        frm_save = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="Save Location for Excel Output")
        frm_save.pack(fill='x', padx=pad, pady=(pad, 5))

        save_row = ttk.Frame(frm_save)
        save_row.pack(fill='x', padx=pad, pady=pad)

        ttk.Label(save_row, text="Folder:").pack(side='left')
        e = ttk.Entry(save_row, textvariable=self.save_dir_var)
        e.pack(side='left', fill='x', expand=True, padx=(5, 5))
        ttk.Button(save_row, text="Browse...", command=self.browse_folder).pack(side='left')

        # Connection settings
        frm_conn = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="SQL Server Connection")
        frm_conn.pack(fill='x', padx=pad, pady=5)

        row1 = ttk.Frame(frm_conn)
        row1.pack(fill='x', padx=pad, pady=5)
        ttk.Label(row1, text="Server:", width=14).pack(side='left')
        ttk.Entry(row1, textvariable=self.server_var).pack(side='left', fill='x', expand=True)

        row2 = ttk.Frame(frm_conn)
        row2.pack(fill='x', padx=pad, pady=5)
        ttk.Label(row2, text="Database:", width=14).pack(side='left')
        ttk.Entry(row2, textvariable=self.database_var).pack(side='left', fill='x', expand=True)

        row3 = ttk.Frame(frm_conn)
        row3.pack(fill='x', padx=pad, pady=5)
        ttk.Label(row3, text="Authentication:", width=14).pack(side='left')
        auth = ttk.Combobox(row3, textvariable=self.auth_mode_var, values=["Windows (Integrated)", "SQL Login"], state='readonly')
        auth.pack(side='left', fill='x', expand=True)
        auth.bind('<<ComboboxSelected>>', lambda e: self.update_auth_fields())

        row4 = ttk.Frame(frm_conn)
        row4.pack(fill='x', padx=pad, pady=(5, 10))
        ttk.Label(row4, text="Username:", width=14).pack(side='left')
        self.user_entry = ttk.Entry(row4, textvariable=self.username_var)
        self.user_entry.pack(side='left', fill='x', expand=True, padx=(0,5))
        ttk.Label(row4, text="Password:").pack(side='left')
        self.pass_entry = ttk.Entry(row4, textvariable=self.password_var, show='*')
        self.pass_entry.pack(side='left', fill='x', expand=True)

        # Run button
        frm_run = ttk.Frame(self)
        frm_run.pack(fill='x', padx=pad, pady=(10, 5))
        self.run_btn = ttk.Button(frm_run, text="Run ART Now!", command=self.on_run_clicked)
        self.run_btn.pack(pady=5)

        # Status
        self.status_var = tk.StringVar(value=f"SQL folder: {SQL_FOLDER}")
        ttk.Label(self, textvariable=self.status_var, foreground="#555").pack(fill='x', padx=pad, pady=(0, pad))

    def browse_folder(self):
        d = filedialog.askdirectory(title="Choose a save folder", initialdir=self.save_dir_var.get() or self.default_save_dir())
        if d:
            self.save_dir_var.set(d)

    def update_auth_fields(self):
        mode = self.auth_mode_var.get()
        if mode == "Windows (Integrated)":
            self.user_entry.configure(state='disabled')
            self.pass_entry.configure(state='disabled')
        else:
            self.user_entry.configure(state='normal')
            self.pass_entry.configure(state='normal')

    def on_run_clicked(self):
        # Validate inputs
        save_dir = self.save_dir_var.get().strip()
        if not save_dir:
            messagebox.showerror("Missing folder", "Please choose a save location for the Excel file.")
            return
        if not os.path.isdir(save_dir):
            messagebox.showerror("Invalid folder", "The save location is not a valid folder.")
            return

        if not os.path.isdir(SQL_FOLDER):
            messagebox.showerror("SQL folder missing", f"The SQL folder does not exist:\n{SQL_FOLDER}")
            return

        server = self.server_var.get().strip()
        database = self.database_var.get().strip()
        if not server or not database:
            messagebox.showerror("Missing connection info", "Please enter both Server and Database.")
            return

        auth_mode = self.auth_mode_var.get()
        username = self.username_var.get().strip()
        password = self.password_var.get()

        # Disable run button and start thread
        self.run_btn.configure(state='disabled', text='Running...')
        self.status_var.set("Running queries... This may take a few minutes.")

        t = threading.Thread(target=self.run_workflow, args=(save_dir, server, database, auth_mode, username, password), daemon=True)
        t.start()

    def run_workflow(self, save_dir, server, database, auth_mode, username, password):
        try:
            # Connect
            cnxn = try_sql_server_connection(server, database, auth_mode, username, password)
            cursor = cnxn.cursor()

            # Collect SQL files
            sql_files = [f for f in os.listdir(SQL_FOLDER) if f.lower().endswith('.sql')]
            sql_files.sort(key=lambda x: x.lower())

            if not sql_files:
                raise RuntimeError(f"No .sql files found in: {SQL_FOLDER}")

            # Prepare output
            timestamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
            output_path = os.path.join(save_dir, f"ART_Output_{timestamp}.xlsx")

            # Collect DataFrames
            sheets = []  # list of (sheet_name, DataFrame)
            run_log = []  # list of dicts

            # Helper to avoid duplicate sheet names
            sheet_name_counts = {}
            def unique_sheet_name(base: str):
                base = safe_sheet_name(base)
                count = sheet_name_counts.get(base, 0)
                if count == 0:
                    sheet_name_counts[base] = 1
                    return base
                else:
                    sheet_name_counts[base] = count + 1
                    return safe_sheet_name(f"{base}_{count+1}")

            # Execute each file
            for fname in sql_files:
                fpath = os.path.join(SQL_FOLDER, fname)
                try:
                    with open(fpath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                        sql_text = f.read()
                except UnicodeDecodeError:
                    with open(fpath, 'r', encoding='latin-1') as f:
                        sql_text = f.read()

                batches = split_sql_batches(sql_text)
                total_rows = 0
                result_set_index = 0
                this_file_had_results = False

                try:
                    for b in batches:
                        if not b.strip():
                            continue
                        cursor.execute(b)
                        for cols, rows in fetch_all_result_sets(cursor):
                            result_set_index += 1
                            if rows:
                                df = pd.DataFrame.from_records(rows, columns=cols)
                                sn = unique_sheet_name(os.path.splitext(fname)[0] if result_set_index == 1 else f"{os.path.splitext(fname)[0]}_{result_set_index}")
                                sheets.append((sn, df))
                                total_rows += len(rows)
                                this_file_had_results = True
                    run_log.append({
                        'SQL File': fname,
                        'Status': 'OK',
                        'Rows Exported': total_rows
                    })
                except Exception as e:
                    # Log error and continue
                    err = f"{e}"
                    run_log.append({
                        'SQL File': fname,
                        'Status': 'ERROR',
                        'Rows Exported': total_rows,
                        'Error': err
                    })

            # Always create workbook: include results (if any) + Run Log
            with pd.ExcelWriter(output_path, engine='openpyxl') as writer:
                if sheets:
                    for sn, df in sheets:
                        df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sn[:31], index=False)
                # Add Run Log
                log_df = pd.DataFrame(run_log)
                log_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Run Log', index=False)

            # Try to open the file
            try:
                os.startfile(output_path)  # Windows
            except Exception:
                pass

            # Update UI
            msg = f"Completed. Output saved to:\n{output_path}\n\n"
            if sheets:
                msg += f"Sheets exported: {len(sheets)}"
            else:
                msg += "No result sets were returned by the SQL files. See 'Run Log' sheet."

            self.safe_ui_finish(success_message=msg)
        except Exception as e:
            tb = traceback.format_exc()
            self.safe_ui_finish(error_message=f"Failed to complete run.\n\n{e}\n\nDetails:\n{tb}")

    def safe_ui_finish(self, success_message: str = None, error_message: str = None):
        def _finish():
            self.run_btn.configure(state='normal', text='Run ART Now!')
            if success_message:
                self.status_var.set("Done.")
                messagebox.showinfo("ART Runner", success_message)
            if error_message:
                self.status_var.set("Error.")
                messagebox.showerror("ART Runner", error_message)
        # marshal back to main thread
        self.after(0, _finish)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = ARTRunnerApp()
    app.mainloop()
